school: 阿尤布王朝苏丹/圣战统一叙事的完成者/骑士风度声誉政治的典范/逊尼派复兴的执行者
historical_significance: 萨拉丁·优素福·伊本·阿尤布（1137-1193），埃及与叙利亚苏丹、阿尤布王朝创立者。生于提克里特，随父在叙利亚长大，早年在大马士革努尔丁·赞吉宫廷接受教法与军事教育。1169年随叔父希尔库赴埃及解围，同年继任法蒂玛王朝维齐尔；1171年废黜法蒂玛哈里发、恢复逊尼派呼图白，1174年努尔丁死后接管大马士革，此后十余年以圣战为旗号统一埃及-叙利亚-美索不达米亚西部。1187年7月4日哈丁之战歼灭耶路撒冷王国全部机动兵力，俘获国王居伊与真十字架，同年10月收复耶路撒冷——与88年前十字军屠城相反，他禁止屠杀与报复劫掠，居民可赎身离城，穷人的赎金由其本人与兄弟支付。此举及对被俘贵族的宽待，使他在同时代基督徒编年史（如英格兰编年史家的记述）中也赢得"骑士风度"的声誉，成为但丁《天堂篇》中仅有的两位异教徒美德典范之一。第三次十字军东征（1189-1192）中与理查一世鏖战，1192年签订雅法停战协定，十字军保留沿海窄带而耶路撒冷归穆斯林并开放朝觐。他以逊尼派马德拉萨网络置换法蒂玛什叶派宗教机构，重建教法官体系；以家产制（兄弟阿迪尔掌埃及财政与海军、诸子侄分守叙利亚诸城）维系跨区域帝国，并建立精锐马穆鲁克近卫。财政上他把法蒂玛没收地产转为军费田、掌控红海-也门商路过境税、与比萨热那亚缔结贸易协定，使战争拥有可持续预算。1193年病逝于大马士革，个人几乎无私产。其生平经提尔的威廉《编年史》及其后的《萨拉丁传奇》传入欧洲，成为"高贵的敌人"的原型，深刻影响了从文艺复兴到近代欧洲的骑士观念与东方想象。
historical_significance_en: Salah ad-Din Yusuf ibn Ayyub (1137-1193), Sultan of Egypt and Syria and founder of the Ayyubid dynasty. Born in Tikrit and raised in Syria, he was educated in law and arms at Nur ad-Din's court in Damascus. Sent to Egypt in 1169 with his uncle Shirkuh, he became vizier of the Fatimid Caliphate that year; in 1171 he abolished the Fatimid caliphate and restored the Sunni khutba, and after Nur ad-Din's death in 1174 took Damascus, spending the next decade unifying Egypt, Syria, and western Mesopotamia under the banner of jihad. On 4 July 1187 at Hattin he annihilated the entire field army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, capturing King Guy and the True Cross, and in October 1187 recovered Jerusalem—where, unlike the Crusaders' massacre eighty-eight years before, he forbade slaughter and reprisal plunder, allowed residents to ransom themselves, and paid the ransom of the poorest from his own purse. This conduct, and his leniency toward captured nobles, won him a reputation for chivalry even in contemporary Christian chronicles; Dante placed him in the Paradiso among the virtuous pagans. In the Third Crusade (1189-92) he fought Richard I to a standstill and signed the Truce of Jaffa (1192): the Crusaders kept a narrow coastal strip while Jerusalem remained Muslim with pilgrimage open. He replaced Fatimid Shia institutions with a Sunni madrasa network and rebuilt the qadi judiciary; he held his trans-regional empire together by household rule (brother al-Adil over Egyptian finance and the navy, sons and nephews over Syrian cities) with an elite mamluk guard. Fiscally he converted confiscated Fatimid estates into military fiefs, controlled Red Sea-Yemen transit duties, and concluded trade treaties with Pisa and Genoa, giving war a sustainable budget. He died in Damascus in 1193 with almost no private wealth. His life, transmitted through William of Tyre's chronicle and later romance, became Europe's archetype of the "noble enemy," shaping Renaissance and modern chivalric ideals and the European imagination of the East.

cross_references.relation_type: 宽容占领范式的跨文明对读：居鲁士入巴比伦与萨拉丁入耶路撒冷
cross_references.description_zh: 居鲁士前539年入巴比伦、萨拉丁1187年入耶路撒冷，相隔近两千年却共享同一占领范式：以被征服者的神圣文本与符号体系为自身合法性背书（居鲁士圆筒之于马尔杜克、《古兰经》节文之于圣城），以对败者的可见宽待把军事胜利转写为政治承认。二人的对照还揭示了该范式的边界条件——居鲁士的宽容有帝国官僚制托底，可传于后世（亚历山大沿袭）；萨拉丁的宽容系于个人声誉资本与家产网络，人亡则分封裂解。宽容占领是一种强大但易碎的技术路线。
cross_references.description_en: Cyrus entering Babylon in 539 BCE and Saladin entering Jerusalem in 1187 CE share, across two millennia, one occupation paradigm: lending one's legitimacy the conquered's own sacred texts and symbols (the Cyrus Cylinder to Marduk, Qur'anic recitations to the Holy City), and converting military victory into political recognition through visible leniency to the defeated. Their contrast also exposes the paradigm's boundary conditions—Cyrus's tolerance was underwritten by imperial bureaucracy and survived him (Alexander followed it); Saladin's rested on personal reputational capital and a household network that splintered at his death. Tolerant occupation is a powerful but fragile technology.

cross_references.relation_type: 双盆地资源结构的镜像：尼罗河-两河与马其顿-波斯的战争动员
cross_references.description_zh: 萨拉丁的埃及（钱粮）-叙利亚（兵源）双盆地结构与亚历山大的马其顿（兵源）-波斯（财政）结构互为镜像：都以一个资源盆地供养另一盆地的军队，都以联姻与分封降低盆地间转移成本。差异在于亚历山大用官僚制承接波斯财政（行省总督制），萨拉丁用家产制承接埃及财政（兄弟阿迪尔）——前者可移植、后者随血缘稀释。二人合读可见：跨区域战争动员的真正瓶颈从来不是资源总量，而是盆地间的转移成本结构。
cross_references.description_en: Saladin's Egypt (money-grain)-Syria (manpower) dual-basin structure mirrors Alexander's Macedonia (manpower)-Persia (finance): each basin funds the other's army, and marriage and appanage lower inter-basin transfer costs. The difference: Alexander received Persian finance through bureaucracy (satrapal governance), Saladin received Egyptian finance through household rule (brother al-Adil)—the former portable, the latter diluting with bloodline. Read together: the true bottleneck of trans-regional war mobilization is never total resources but the transfer-cost structure between basins.

cross_references.relation_type: 体系极限期的战略自省：提尔之憾与韬光养晦
cross_references.description_zh: 萨拉丁1192年雅法停战承认十字军保留海岸窄带、邓小平"韬光养晦"承认实力边界以待时变，是相隔八百年的同一决策类型：在扩张见顶期，把无法兑现的野心折价出售，换取体系续命的时间与资源。二人的共同前提是对自身体系到期日的清醒审计——萨拉丁审计出海军缺席与分封兵力上限，邓小平审计出技术水平与制度成熟度的时间差。战略自省作为可教习的方法论，在两个完全不同的文明与时代都成立。
cross_references.description_en: Saladin's Truce of Jaffa (1192), ceding the coastal strip, and Deng Xiaoping's "hide capacities and bide time," acknowledging limits of power to await change, are the same decision type eight centuries apart: at the peak of expansion, sell unredeemable ambitions at a discount to buy the system time and resources. Both shared one premise—a clear-eyed audit of their system's expiry date: Saladin audited the absence of a navy and the ceiling of appanaged force concentration; Deng audited the time-lag of technological and institutional maturity. Strategic self-reflection as a teachable methodology holds across civilizations and eras.
